Message.Name: Enter Order Message
Message.Description: The Enter Order Message lets you enter a new order. Each new order must have a Token that is unique to the day and that logical RASH Port account. If you send a valid order, you should receive an Accepted Order Message.

Field.Name: Order Token/Client Order ID
Field.Description: Token must be day unique for each RASH port account.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B/S/T/E: Buy, Sell, Short, Short Exempt. For sell short and sell short exempt, the subscriber affirms the ability to borrow securities in good deliverable form for delivery within three business days.

Field.Name: Shares/OrderQty
Field.Description: Total number of shares entered. Must be greater than zero.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price, 6 whole and 4 implied decimal digits.

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: The number of seconds that this order should live before being automatically canceled; special values (0 = Immediate or Cancel, 99998 = Market Day, 99999 = system day and the others the document lists) are listed in section 2.1.1.

Field.Name: Firm/Client ID
Field.Description: MPID.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Display instruction; see the Display values.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum fill amount allowed.

Field.Name: Max Floor
Field.Description: Shares to display. If zero this field will default to the order quantity. Use the display field to specify a hidden order.

Field.Name: Peg Type
Field.Description: Peg type.

Field.Name: Peg Difference Sign
Field.Description: + or -. If peg type is set to N, specify +.

Field.Name: Peg Difference
Field.Description: Amount; 6.4 (implied decimal). If peg type is set to N, specify 0.

Field.Name: Discretion Price
Field.Description: Discretion Price for Discretionary Order. If set to 0, this order does not have discretion.

Field.Name: Discretion Peg Type
Field.Description: Discretion peg type.

Field.Name: Discretion Peg Difference Sign
Field.Description: + or -. If peg type is set to N, specify +.

Field.Name: Discretion Peg Difference
Field.Description: Amount; 6.4 (implied decimal). If peg type is set to N, specify 0.

Field.Name: Capacity/Rule 80A Indicator
Field.Description: Capacity code.

Field.Name: Random Reserve
Field.Description: Shares to do random reserve with.

Field.Name: Route Dest/Exec Broker
Field.Description: Target ID: a routing strategy or a directed order destination code.

Field.Name: Cust/Terminal ID/Sender SubID
Field.Description: Client initiated; pass-thru. Must be left-justified.

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: Requests that an order be canceled. A Shares field of zero cancels the entire balance of the order; otherwise Shares is the new intended order size.

Field.Name: Order Token/Client Order ID
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Specify zero to cancel the order; otherwise the new intended order size.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages signal events that affect the entire system.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See System Event Codes.

Message.Name: Canceled Order Message
Message.Description: A Canceled Order Message informs you that an order has been reduced or canceled. Canceled shares reflect the number of shares that are out.

Field.Name: Order Token/Client Order ID
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares.

Field.Name: Cancel Reason
Field.Description: The reason the order was reduced or canceled. See Cancel Order Reasons.

Message.Name: Rejected Order Message
Message.Description: A Rejected Order Message may be sent in response to an Enter Order Message if the order cannot be accepted at this time. The Token of a rejected order cannot be re-used.

Field.Name: Order Token/Client Order ID
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message.

Field.Name: Reject Reason
Field.Description: See Rejected Order Reasons.

Message.Name: Executed Order Message
Message.Description: An Executed Order Message informs you that all or part of an order has been executed.

Field.Name: Order Token/Client Order ID
Field.Description: The Order Token as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price at which the execution occurred.

Field.Name: Liquidity
Field.Description: See Liquidity Flags.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Assigned to each match executed. Each match consists of one buy and one sell; the matching buy and sell executions share the same match number.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: A Broken Trade Message informs you that an execution has been broken. The trade is no longer good and will not clear.

Field.Name: Order Token
Field.Description: The order Token field as entered.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Assigned to each match executed. Each match consists of one buy and one sell; the matching buy and sell executions share the same match number.

Field.Name: Broken Trade Reason
Field.Description: The reason the trade was broken. See Broken Trade Reasons.

Value.Name: Post Only
Value.Description: Post-Only (For stocks over $1, BX Post Only Orders will remove liquidity at any price equal to or better than its limit.)

Value.Name: Directed To Long Term Stock Exchange
Value.Description: Directed order to Long Term Stock Exchange

Value.Name: Not A Reactive Trade Now
Value.Description: Not a Reactive Trade Now order

Value.Name: Immediately Live
Value.Description: Order is immediately live (don't wait for a cross)

Value.Name: Start Of Day
Value.Description: Start of Day. This is always the first message each day. It indicates that the system is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: End Of Day
Value.Description: End of Day. This indicates that the system is now closed and will not accept any new orders in this session. There will not be any more executions during this session, however, it is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Canceled Order Messages.

Value.Name: User Requested Cancel
Value.Description: User requested cancel. Sent in response to a Cancel Request Message.

Value.Name: Timeout
Value.Description: Timeout. The Time In Force for this order has expired

Value.Name: Supervisory
Value.Description: Supervisory. The order was manually canceled or reduced by a supervisory terminal.

Value.Name: Regulatory Restriction
Value.Description: This order cannot be executed because of a regulatory restriction (e.g.: trade through restrictions).

Value.Name: Self Match Prevention
Value.Description: Self Match Prevention. The order was cancelled because it would have executed with an existing order entered by the same MPID.

Value.Name: System Cancel
Value.Description: System cancel. This order was cancelled by the system.

Value.Name: Market Collars
Value.Description: This order cannot be executed because of Market Collars

Value.Name: Closed
Value.Description: Closed. Any DAY order that was received after the closing cross is complete in a given symbol will receive this cancel reason.

Value.Name: Rejected By Away Destination
Value.Description: System cancel. This order was cancelled because it was rejected by an away destination; includes midpoint orders cancelled due to a crossed market.

Value.Name: Administrative Cancel
Value.Description: Administrative cancel. This order was cancelled by the system.

Value.Name: Other
Value.Description: Other. A reason not contemplated in this version of RASH.
